locator.text: Equation (5.18), p. 52, in the proof of Lemma 5.2

evidence: paper: E_n = U_n = F_n = V_n = 0 \quad \text{on the reserved mean patch } \mathcal{I}_{\mathrm{mean}},\ \text{for every } n \ge 1

provenance.note: machine audit: worker, gate, reviewer; not confirmed by a human

verdicts.summary: Lean uses a different formula here. Two of the four clauses are stated on a region containing the mean patch, two only further out. `positive_fields_zero` gives φ_n = 0 and U_n = 0 for every X ≥ ReservedPatches.right .positive and |η| ≤ 1, and `positive_before_mean` puts the mean patch strictly to the right of that, so E_n = √(2X)φ_n/C = 0 and U_n = 0 there; this is stronger than the paper's statement, which only asks for the patch. For F_n and V_n no declaration was found that asserts vanishing on the mean patch: what is stated is F_n = 0 for X ≥ s.B²/2 (`extended_axial_primitive_zero`, `aligned_mass_primitive_zero` with s.B = nominalOuterRadius W) and V_n/X = 0 for R ≥ s.B (`profiles_beta_exterior`), and that radius is strictly beyond every reserved patch: nominalOuterX W = max(radius, pulseEndRadius, right .positive) + 1 (AssembledSlowBase.lean:846), while all four patches sit at radius·exp(pulseStart + offset) with offsets in [-25,-3] (ReservedPatches.lean:29-39), hence inside pulseEndRadius = radius·exp(pulseStart + pulseLength). The paper's mean-patch versions do follow in a few lines from stated declarations, by the paper's own argument: `fluxHistory_exterior_on` instantiated at B = √(2·right .positive) — its hypotheses are U_n = 0 past that radius (`profiles_outer_axial` / `positive_fields_zero`) and the vanishing first moment ∫_{R>0} R·U_n dR = 0 (row 0 of `profiles_moments`) — gives V_n = 0 there, and its proof obtains the mass history F_n = 0 as the intermediate step `hmass` (PositiveOrderMoments.lean:747-750). No declaration found performs that instantiation at the patch radius, so the display as written was not checked; the content is.
